_note: Aggregate cohort-level statistics only. experiment3_window_provenance.csv (one row per decision point, patient-level granularity) is deliberately NOT published here -- see ../DATA_ACCESS.md.

manuscript_draft_figures_superseded.note: Superseded after two confirmed bugs were fixed: (1) a WRITE_APPEND join-fanout that could silently duplicate cohort rows on re-run, and (2) a sum-vs-union overlap computation that double-counted time when a patient had overlapping multi-drug pressor therapy (34.8% of stays). See ROADMAP.md, 'Resolved -- Experiment 3 window-overlap discrepancy explained' for the full diagnostic trail, including a synthetic duplication test (N=1/2/5/15) that reproduced the original figures almost exactly at the independently-derived duplication ratio.
